story.title: Protesters Form Human Chain at Kennedy Center Over Demolition Fears
story.summary: Protesters gathered at the Kennedy Center to form a human chain, expressing their concerns over potential demolition threats from the Trump administration. The demonstration, titled 'Hands Around the Kennedy Center,' aimed to highlight demands for the removal of Trump as chairman for his perceived failure to protect the arts venue.

related_stories.title: Ed Sheeran Addresses Gaza Conflict After Macklemore Controversy at Concert
related_stories.summary: During his first concert since dropping Macklemore for pro-Palestinian comments, Ed Sheeran described the situation in Gaza as 'catastrophic and unjustifiable.' He acknowledged making 'mistakes' regarding the controversy surrounding his opening act. The incident has led to criticism and the withdrawal of several other support acts from the tour, with mixed reactions from concertgoers.

related_stories.title: Panic and Protests Follow Deaths of Miners in Nigerian Custody
related_stories.summary: In Nigeria's Minna, 37 suspected illegal goldminers died in a prison cell, prompting panic among survivors who struggled to breathe. Protests erupted in response, leading police to fire teargas and impose an overnight curfew. Armed security forces have been deployed to manage the unrest following the incident, which has drawn significant public outcry.
